title: Maximum Product of Two Integers With No Common Bits
summary: Given an integer array, identify two distinct indices where the product of the corresponding values is maximized, with the condition that their binary representations have no shared bits.
statement: Given an integer array, identify two distinct indices where the product of the corresponding values is maximized, with the condition that their binary representations have no shared bits. Return the highest product meeting these criteria, or 0 if no such pair exists.
constraints: Two to 100,000 positive values up to one million.
Choose distinct indices whose values have bitwise AND zero.
Return the maximum product, or zero if no pair qualifies.
hints: A partner for value v must be a submask of the complement of v.
Store the largest present value per mask and run subset-max DP.
Propagate maxima from each mask with one bit removed, then multiply every value by the best complement submask.
After SOS DP, best[mask] is the largest input contained in mask, so the complement query considers exactly all disjoint-bit partners.
editorial: After SOS DP, best[mask] is the largest input contained in mask, so the complement query considers exactly all disjoint-bit partners.
